summary.text: Mahesh Ganorkar is the Republican nominee challenging incumbent Valerie Foushee in North Carolina's 4th Congressional District. He holds an M.B.A. and has worked on U.S.-India business joint ventures and home design, and left his career to be a stay-at-home father. He previously ran in Republican congressional primaries in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: In his 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Mahesh Ganorkar described being born and brought up in a farming family, immigrating from a socialist country, and later living in New Jersey before moving to North Carolina.
He holds an M.B.A., and his professional experience includes facilitating international joint ventures between U.S. and Indian companies and residential construction and home design.

He said on his 2024 campaign website that after his first child was born he decided to give up his career to be a stay-at-home dad, and in his 2022 survey he said he also home-schooled his three children.
Ganorkar says his political activism began in 2009, when he founded a Tea Party group in New Jersey that he ran until his family moved to North Carolina.
He ran in the May 17, 2022 Republican primary for North Carolina's 2nd Congressional District, won by Christine Villaverde.
In the March 5, 2024 Republican primary for the 4th District, he received about 30 percent to Eric Blankenburg's roughly 70 percent.
He advanced as the 2026 Republican nominee after the March 3, 2026 primary for the 4th District was uncontested.
